name: KK 65 (Hubble)
blurb: KK 65, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: kk65-hubble
story: KK 65 is one of a handful of dwarf galaxies gathered in a loose association whose brightest member is UGC 3974. Hubble measured their distances to test whether such faint groups are held together mostly by dark matter.

claims.text: KK 65 is a Magellanic irregular galaxy
KK 65 is also cataloged as CG 87-33
KK 65 is a member of the 14+19 association of dwarf galaxies, whose brightest galaxy is UGC 3974
Hubble program 10210 'Groups of Dwarf Galaxies: Pools of Mostly Dark Matter?' measured distances to dwarf galaxies in dwarf groups
